text:
If you’re chasing the last bit of daylight, expect a mostly cloudy sunset around 6:20, with a stray shower still possible. Showers may pop up again this evening, but they should stay light and scattered, with the better chance before 11. It’ll turn cooler overnight, down to around 46, with southwest winds and a lake running 1 to 3 feet.

Friday looks like a cooler, mostly cloudy follow-up, with a high near 58 and showers most likely during the morning. The models aren’t fully settled on how wet it gets, so I’d keep the rain jacket handy even if the afternoon looks like the better bet for a break. On the lake, west winds of 10 to 15 knots and 1-to-3-foot waves make for a choppy morning. Plan outdoor time tonight before 11, and aim for Friday afternoon if you want the best shot at staying dry.
